searchText: anybody knows how accurate these storage numbers are: https://etherscan.io/chartsync/chaindefault this lists geth storage requirements as > 1TB, but I suspect these might be obtained by querying a running node every day, without pruning it? has someone done a fresh non-archive sync of geth recently? was is the real space requirement? <@!329594653097721856> I'd be curious about these numbers for Erigon too to be clear I'm talking about disk requirements necessary to run the chain, not just the state size <@!218397452309495809> within the last couple months, a fresh sync of geth has been ~450gb for me Anyone know the rough size of a fully synced Erigon node? Around 1.6TB, according to one of my nodes

excerpts.content:
anybody knows how accurate these storage numbers are: https://etherscan.io/chartsync/chaindefault
this lists geth storage requirements as > 1TB, but I suspect these might be obtained by querying a running node every day, without pruning it?

has someone done a fresh non-archive sync of geth recently? was is the real space requirement?

<@!329594653097721856> I'd be curious about these numbers for Erigon too

to be clear I'm talking about disk requirements necessary to run the chain, not just the state size
